title: Forsaken Plus [Invicible,Autogen and more]
features:
A open source script that works in forsaken and in forsaken clone games

• Invincible (does not work on clones)
» You can become invisible and have god mode while still being able to use abilities like normal and do generators
• Auto Generator(s)
» The generator that you try to fix will be automatically completed
• Stamina preset
» Allows you to sprint for longer based on the preset you put (even infinite)
• Anti Slowness
» Removes all slowness effects applied to your character
• Animation Changer
» Changes your animations in game to different characters
• ESP
» Allows you to see objects/players through walls currently these are [ Killer(s), Survivor(s), Generator(s), Item(s) ]
• Private Server Features
» There are some features that can only be used if you are the private server owner (commands access) which are overpowered
• And more
» There are even more features not mentioned which you can find out by using the script

Some forsaken clone games mainly supported:
Codename: Redux (86635275427451)
Forgotten (79332922783695)
Unlearned (116432988954341)
Eternal (138663073083252)
Jokesaken (79214018458217)
Samsaken (72607202320484)
Project Deadlight (105467949519088)
& more
